critical_evidence.evidence_identity_description: Deleted text file recovered as orphan file 'mima.txt' in $OrphanFiles: a password/credential ledger listing the persona document password (0987654321), a transfer-record archive password (eioo99390) and an ETH wallet address.
'包装例1.docx' under /话术/: a fabricated persona profile ('陈智宸 / Richard', 37, textile trader) used to package a fake identity for victim-facing chat.
'7要素.docx' under /话术/: a script for extracting victims' personal details (home/company address etc.), i.e. an information-collection playbook.

supporting_evidence.evidence_identity_description: '拒绝视频话术.txt': script lines to refuse photo/video-call requests while keeping the chat going (identity-concealment tactic).
'聊天话术1.docx': chat scripts with platform-download instructions (an 'AP' via URL) used to steer victims onto a target platform.
'老师包装.txt': promotional copy packaging 'Mati Greenspan' as a famous, trusted cryptocurrency analyst.

expected_questions.text: Does this device contain evidence of a scripted, persona-based fraud operation (话术/包装 materials)?
Is there evidence tying the scripts to an actual identification of the operator's real-world identity?
expected_questions.notes: The materials implicate persona use, but no artifact identifies the real operator; 'unresolved' is the correct terminal state and must not be forced to an answer.

confirmed_claims.proposition: A credential ledger (mima.txt) existed on the device, listing passwords for persona/transfer materials and an ETH wallet address, and was deleted from the live filesystem (recovered only as an orphan file).
The device holds fabricated persona materials (packaged identities for a 'Richard/陈智宸' persona and a promoted 'analyst' persona) together with scripts for concealing identity (refusing video calls).
The script set is consistent with a romance/investment fraud operation: info-extraction playbooks, chat scripts and platform-onboarding steps exist alongside the persona materials.

acceptable_inferences.proposition: The combination of persona packaging, refusal scripts and an information-extraction playbook indicates a coordinated scripted social-engineering operation.

unsupported_or_prohibited_overclaims.proposition: The operator has been identified as a specific real person.
unsupported_or_prohibited_overclaims.notes: No evidence in this dataset attributes the activity to any real-world individual; actor attribution is prohibited.

unsupported_or_prohibited_overclaims.proposition: The ETH wallet address in mima.txt received victim funds.
unsupported_or_prohibited_overclaims.notes: Wallet address presence does not establish any transaction; blockchain-transaction claims are prohibited here.

unsupported_or_prohibited_overclaims.proposition: The same username on the materials proves a specific user operated all listed accounts.
unsupported_or_prohibited_overclaims.notes: same-username != same-identity trap: identity merges are prohibited on this evidence.

expected_relations.notes: Passwords in the ledger unlock/refer to the persona and transfer materials — a same-device correlation, NOT an identity attribution.

expected_coverage.description: On-chain activity of the wallet address is not obtainable from this dataset.
